items.description: Each entry ends with a kind badge: for software you can run, and a gray badge for , , , , , , , , for organizations, and for commercial products and vendor pages. Plain entries are articles. Entries marked unmaintained point at archived or abandoned projects kept for reference.
items.title: Legend
Experiment Impact Tracker
items.description: A Python library that calculates the carbon cost of a machine learning job; unmaintained, archived October 2025.

items.title: AXIOMAX ESG Carbon Shield
items.description: An MIT-licensed SDK for Python, Node.js, and Bash that signs AI inference calls with ed25519 and SHA-256 hash chains to produce auditable carbon attestations for CSRD and SEC reporting; calibration coefficients and keys remain server-side, and the project advertises a pending USPTO patent.

items.title: ebb-ai
items.description: An Apache-2.0 MCP server exposing nine tools that defer non-urgent LLM jobs to the cleanest grid hour within a deadline across 31 regions, logging per-task carbon receipts to SQLite. (source)

items.title: carbontracker
items.description: Tracks and predicts the energy consumption and carbon footprint of training deep learning models, as described in Anthony et al. (2020).

items.title: FedZero
items.description: A federated learning system for zero-carbon distributed AI training, successor to Lowcarb, which won the GSF CarbonHack 2022. (paper)

items.title: kube-green
items.description: An open-source Kubernetes addon that automatically shuts down selected resources when you do not need them.

items.title: Carbonifer
items.description: A command line tool to estimate and control the carbon emissions of cloud infrastructure before it is provisioned.

items.title: Kernel Tuner
items.description: An auto-tuner capable of optimizing GPU code for energy efficiency.

items.title: Creedengo (formerly ecoCode)
items.description: SonarQube plugins for PHP, Python, Java, JavaScript, and more, providing static analyzers that highlight code structures with a negative ecological impact.

items.title: Tracarbon
items.description: Tracks a device's energy consumption and calculates carbon emissions using your location.

items.title: JoularJX
items.description: Java software power monitoring at the source code level, in real time.

items.title: energy-consumption-measuring-toolkit
items.description: Accenture's RAPL-based toolkit for measuring the energy consumption of Python applications.

items.title: CarbonLint
items.description: An MIT-licensed Tauri/Rust desktop app and npm CLI that tracks CPU, memory, disk, network, and GPU use, converts it to CO2 via regional grid intensity, and scores projects 0-100.

items.title: carbon-text
items.description: A syntax highlighter and snippets extension for carbon.txt files.

items.title: Green CodeQL
items.description: A GPL-3.0 collection of custom CodeQL queries flagging energy-related sustainability issues across six packs covering Java/Kotlin, Python, C/C++, JavaScript, C#, and GitHub Actions.

items.title: Carbon Aware SDK
items.description: A Web API and command line for unified forecast and historical power grid emissions data by location and time, to help build carbon-aware software.

items.title: Carbon Aware Computing — Tools and Free Forecast Data
items.description: A NuGet package, PowerShell cmdlets, and a live SDK instance, plus an open carbon forecast for Europe in the Carbon Aware SDK's JSON format.

items.title: GreenScheduled
items.description: An Apache-2.0 Java library adding a annotation for Spring Boot and Quarkus that shifts jobs to the lowest-carbon hour in a window using the carbonintensity.io API.

items.title: Carbon Aware Computing Hangfire Extension
items.description: A Hangfire extension that schedules tasks into the window of minimal grid carbon intensity, based on emission forecasts.

items.title: PSElectricityMaps
items.description: A PowerShell module for retrieving current power grid carbon emissions data with a free Electricity Maps or CO2signal account.

items.title: Carbon AppInsights
items.description: An Azure Functions solution logging Electricity Maps emissions data for Azure regions into Azure Monitor for alerting triggers and automated actions.

items.title: PSWattTime
items.description: A PowerShell module for retrieving current power grid carbon emissions data with a free WattTime.org account.

items.title: scaphandre
items.description: Power measurement for bare metal hosts, Prometheus, and workloads inside Docker containers.

items.title: Kepler
items.description: The Kubernetes-based Efficient Power Level Exporter uses eBPF to probe energy-related system stats and exports them as Prometheus metrics.

items.title: Eco-CI
items.description: A plugin for GitHub Actions and GitLab that measures CI runs and estimates their energy use.

items.title: PowerJoular
items.description: Monitors the power consumption of software and hardware components in real time.

items.title: Vessim
items.description: A co-simulation testbed for carbon-aware applications, connecting renewable generation and energy storage simulators to real software and hardware; published at HotCarbon'24. (source)

items.title: ipmitool
items.description: Reads the power consumption of a bare metal machine through DCMI, the IPMI extension.

items.title: PowerTOP
items.description: A Linux tool to diagnose issues with power consumption and power management.

items.title: turbostress
items.description: Generates load on a machine and outputs the computer's power metrics for that load.

items.title: CO2.js
items.description: An npm module for accessing the Green Web API and estimating the carbon emissions of digital services.

items.title: ec0lint
items.description: A static code analysis tool providing hints for reducing the carbon footprint of websites.

items.title: Carbonara
items.description: A custom element from Digital4Better that displays the carbon footprint of web navigation.

The Green Software Foundation Directory helps developers, organizations, and enthusiasts find and contribute to projects that reduce carbon emissions and promote sustainability in software development.
items.title: About the Directory

items.description: Use the contribution form available on the website to add new projects or resources to the directory. Contributions are subject to review to ensure they meet the sustainability criteria of the Green Software Foundation.
